Price overlay for Path of Exile 2: meteor / Verisium Remnant reward prices, item under cursor, inventory run profit, stash tab value, farming sessions and Expedition island rumour ratings. Prices from poe.ninja.

## Download

- **poe2verlay-setup-*.exe**: installer. No admin rights needed; adds a Start menu shortcut and optionally a desktop shortcut and start with Windows.
- **poe2verlay.exe**: portable version, just run it.

Needs Windows 10 2004+ or 11 (x64), the game client in English and the game in Windowed Fullscreen. The exe isn't signed, so SmartScreen may warn on first start: More info → Run anyway.

Hotkeys and details are in the [README](https://github.com/flyingMooncake/Poe2verlay#readme).
